name: Relevance
description: The extent to which the summary covers the key points and main ideas of the original article.
scale: 1-5, with 1 being not relevant and 5 being highly relevant

name: Coherence
description: The logical flow and clarity of the summary, ensuring that it is easy to understand and follow.
scale: 1-5, with 1 being incoherent and 5 being highly coherent

name: Conciseness
description: The ability of the summary to convey the main points succinctly without unnecessary details.
scale: 1-5, with 1 being very verbose and 5 being very concise

name: Accuracy
description: The faithfulness of the summary to the original content, avoiding misrepresentation or omission of key facts.
scale: 1-5, with 1 being highly inaccurate and 5 being highly accurate

name: Engagement
description: The ability of the summary to capture and maintain the reader's interest.
scale: 1-5, with 1 being unengaging and 5 being highly engaging
